purpose: Task 78I Stage 4 -- proves the ONE new dashboard route (GET /piv/status on the EXISTING dashboard_web.py aiohttp server) is genuinely additive, read-only, and reconciles to durable records.
server: dashboard_web.py (existing, unmodified aiohttp app -- default localhost:8787, loopback only)
handler: dashboard_web.py::piv_status_handler -- calls talonx_piv.observability.build_integrated_projection(state_dir) fresh on every request, returns it as JSON
existing_routes_touched: none -- `/`, `/static/*`, `/ws` are byte-identical, confirmed by test_existing_routes_unaffected
no_piv_awareness_before_this_task: confirmed by grep in Task 77I's own research (re-verified by the Stage 0 subagent this task) -- zero references to talonx_piv/piv_events/PIV anywhere in dashboard.py/dashboard_web.py/dashboard_web_static/ before this change

separation_from_general_pipeline_counter: the existing dashboard's own Redis-channel counters (ChannelStats, /ws broadcast) are completely untouched and remain fully separate from /piv/status's payload -- no merging of PIV counters with general-pipeline counters anywhere

Proven by test_piv_status_route_reports_read_failure_explicitly.
